Attack on C.M. of Andhra
Pradesh
*21. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI R.P. GOEN KA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government took note of
the seriousness of the attack on Chief
Minister of Andhra Pradesh by People's
War Group near Tirupati on 1st of October
this year;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
activities of the Left Wing extremists are on
rise in the country;

of lives of VVIPs by the Naxalites; and

strengthen the security provided to the
VVIPs like Chief Ministers ?

PMGSY in Himachal Pradesh
†*22. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of  RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
construction work of the roads sanctioned
under PMGSY in Himachal Pradesh during
2000-2001 and 2001-2002 has not been
completed till now;
(b) whether Government propose to
initiate any action against the contractors
who have failed to complete construction
of roads as per schedule;
(c) whether Government propose to
assign construction work of roads to
Himachal Pradesh Public Works
Department in future;
(d) whether Government have received
any proposal from Himachal Pradesh
Government under PMGS Y for 2002-
2003; and

Coal shortage
*23. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
would head towards a severe coal shortage
and the demand-supply gap is likely to
widen  from 55 million tonnes by the end
of Tenth Plan (2006-07) to about 95 million
tonnes at the end of Eleventh Five Year
Plan period;
(b) whether this would require doubling
of coal production to meet the projected
demand;
(c) if so, the details of the action plan in
this regard; and
(d) whether Government propose to
involve private sector in coal mining to
bridge this gap?
Textile package for J&K artisans
*24. SHRI B.J. PANDA:  Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have drawn
up a textile package for Jammu and Kashmir
artisans;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such kind of package has
also been considered for the most backward
and cash-strapped State of Orissa; and
(d) if so, the  details thereof?
Missing of Computers alongwith
classified data
*25. SHRI K.B.KRISHNA MURTHY:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there was a recent theft of
more than 20 computers from the DRDO
Delhi alongwith classified data on India's
defence strategy;
(b) if so, whether these stolen computers
stored sensitive data of the Institute of
Systems Studies and Analysis and
encryption data relating to India's nuclear
command; and
(c) if so, whether any probe has been
ordered through IB/RAW in this matter,
and if so, the progress made so far ?
Insecurity amongst women in
Delhi
†*26. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
SHRI. NILOTPAL BASU:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an
atmosphere of insecurity has prevailed
among women in Delhi as a result incidents
of eve teasing and rape of a foreigner;
(b) if so, the details of incidents that
occurred during last six months;
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
Government to curb such incidents; and
(d) How does Delhi compare with other
Metros during the corresponding period
with city-wise details for Delhi, Mumbai,
Kolkata and Chennai ?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

9
Reconstitution of Cantonment
Boards
†*27. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether all Cantonment Boards have
been reconstituted;
(b) if so, whether civilian
representatives have also been nominated
on these Boards; and
(c) if not, the names of the Boards where
such nominations have not been made and
by when these are proposed to be made?
Revised wage package for workers
of NTC mills
*28. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI N.R. DASARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has directed the Central Government
to work out a revised wage package within
four months for the National Textile
Corporation mill workers; and
(b) if so, the details and the action taken
by Government thereon?
Women personnel in Paramilitary
Forces
*29. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of number of women
personnel in Para military Force, Rapid
Action Force and Riot Control Police;
(b) whether this number of women
personnel in these forces is sufficient to
tackle any kind of violent protests, insurgency
or rioting in case women are involved on a
large scale;
(c) if not, whether Government propose
to induct more women personnel in these
forces; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Communal riots in Gujarat
*30. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
SHRI NILOTPAL BASU:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of incidents of communal
riots that took place in Gujarat after Gujarat
carnage;
(b) the causes responsible for the
recurrence of these incidents in Gujarat; and
(c) what steps are being taken to
ensure peace and communal harmony in
the State?
Policemen killed during naxalite
activities
†*31.  SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that naxalite
activities have increased manifold in the
country during recent days;
(b) the details of naxalites and policemen
killed State-wise and year-wise during last
five years; and
(c) the year-wise and state-wise details
of the amount disbursed as compensation
to the family members of policemen killed?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

Objections to Electricity Bill, 2003
*32. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sometime
back, the Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh
raised some serious objections with regard
to the Electricity Bill, 2003 passed by
Parliament;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) Government's reaction thereto and
action taken/proposed to be taken thereon?
Availability of coal in collieries
*33. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to refer to
reply to Unstarred Question No. 1804
given in the Rajya Sabha on 6th August,
2003 and  state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is
availability of coal in the collieries which
have been specified by the Hon'ble High
Court, Jharkhand; and
(b) if not, what is the production of the
collieries named Amlo, New Sel, Dhori,
Karo Khasmahal, Jarangdih and Sel Dhori
since January, 2003 onwards?
Provision of helicopters for
security forces
*34. SHRI PRITHVIRAJ CHAVAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that various State
Governments have requested that
helicopters be provided to security forces
in the naxalite and terrorist affected areas;
and
(b) if so, what decision Government
have taken in this regard?
Purchase of AJT
*35. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) present status of purchase of
Advanced Jet Trainers (AJT);
(b) whether it is a fact that there has
been delay in the price negotiation; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Conference of the Inter-State
Council at Srinagar
*36. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
SHRI P. PRABHAKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a conference of the Inter-
State Council was held in Srinagar a few
months back;
(b) if so, whether the Chief Minister of
Andhra Pradesh made a suggestion for the
amendment of Article 365 of the
Constitution which was supported by the
majority of Chief Ministers;
(c) if so, the details thereof including
other matters considered and decisions
taken therein; and
(d) whether any follow-up action has
been taken with regard thereto and if so,
the details thereof?

11
Task Force on power sector
investments and reforms
*37. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether in a bid to attract
investments in the power sector and turn
the enabling provisions of the new
Electricity Act into investment
opportunities, the Government has decided
to constitute a Task Force on power sector
investments and reforms;
(b) if so, what were the main points of
reference made to this Task Force; and
(c) if so, to what extent the Task Force
has been able to boost the investments and
reforms in the power sector?
Crimes against women and Children
*38. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been an alarming
rise in crimes against children in various
parts of the country;
(b) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to check the alarming rise of crimes
against women, children and foreign tourists
in the country; and
(c) whether Centre has in consultation
with State Governments formulated any
programmes of action in cur bing these
crimes?
Pooyamkutty Hydroelectric
power project of Kerala
*39. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the proposal regarding
Hydroelectric power project viz.
Pooyamkutty project, submitted by the
competent authority of Kerala State is
under consideration;
(b) if so, the details regarding the year
of submission and status of such project as
on date;
(c) whether the Tropical Botanical
Garden Research Institute (TBGRI) has
submitted the Environmental impact
assessment report on the project; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Project proposals under
Swajaldhara Scheme
*40. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of project proposals
under Swajaldhara Scheme submitted by
Andhra Pradesh and other Southern States
of the country since the inception of the
Scheme, State-wise;
(b) the number of proposals cleared so
far, State-wise;
(c) if not, the reasons for non-clearance
of proposals, State-wise; and
(d) the steps proposed to be taken to
clear the proposals?

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 3, 2003/Agrahayana 12, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal; Defence; Home Affairs; Mines; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—87
24
Private participation in coal trade
109. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to liberalise norms for
allotment of captive blocks of coal mines to
private sector and permit trading of coal
through private participation; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including the
specific blocks, if any, for such allotments?
Promoting coal sector in Madhya
Pradesh
110. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
promote the coal sector in Madhya Pradesh
with the help of State Government; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Import of defective navigation
equipment by O.F., Medak
111. SHRI MURLI DEORA : Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ordnance
Factory, Medak imported navigation
equipments;
(b) if so, the details and cost thereof;
(c) whether C & AG vide his report
No. 6 of 2003 has observed that these
equipments were defective and were not
verified and tested during the period of
warranty;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the loss caused and action taken in
the matter?
Joint exercises between IAF and
British Special Air Services
112. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Indian Air Force is likely to
have joint exercises with British Special
Air Services;
(b) whether details in this regard have
been finalised; and
(c) when these exercises are likely to be
held?

2
Establishment of Defence
University in Haryana
113. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a Defence University in Haryana;
(b) if so, the place where this University
is to be set up; and
(c) by when the work in this regard is
likely to start and the University would
become functional?
Production of SU-30 by HAL
114. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that HAL propose
to bring out SU 30s next year;
(b) if so, whether our engineers are now
fully capable of manufacturing this in the
country, and how our engineers are proposed
to be trained; and
(c) whether all the problems which earlier
had dogged the engine system, have been
sorted out and a fully safe-proof system has
been developed by our own men?
Defence deals approved and
sanctioned
115. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the year-wise details of defence
deals/projects involving upgradation of
equipment/arms approved and sanctioned
in the last three years and the amount of
funds sanctioned therefor;
(b) whether all the approved projects/
deals have been completed;
(c) if so, the amount of funds utilized
till date;
(d) if not, the number of projects still
pending and when they are expected to be
completed; and
(e) whether any delay has occurred in
any deal/project and if so, the reasons
therefor?
Tripartite treaty for development of
AWACS
116. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has recently signed a Tripartite treaty with
Israel and Russia for developing AWACS;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of funds involved in the
whole project; and
(d) the number of such AWACS planes
that would be developed and where they
would be deployed?
Development of indigenous
Airborne Early Warning and
Control System
117. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India has decided to develop
its indigenous Airborne Early Warning and
Control System;
(b) if so, whether help from other
countries will be sought for this project;
(c) if so, the countries whose help will
be obtained; and
(d) the details in thi s regard?

3
Medium of defence service
examinations
118. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to include Hindi to be one of the medium of
defence service examinations;
(b) if so, the reasons for such a decision;
whether this decision will put the aspiring
candidates from the Hindi region at an
advantageous position;
(c) whether Government propose to
include all recognized regional languages in
the question papers;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Chief of Defence Staff
119. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPT A:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to establish the post for a Chief of
Defence Staff who will oversee and control
all three arms of the services; and
(b) if so, when will this structural change
in the armed forces be effected and the
views of Government on this?
Joint control centres at IAF
airbases
120. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the IAF
decided to consider setting up of joint control
centres at IAF's airbases so as to enable the
civilian aircraft can be parked in IAF
controlled air space;
(b) how the Ministry of Defence is
co-ordinating with the Ministry of Civil
Aviation in this regard;
(c) whether the Ministry of Defence
suggested to the Ministry of Civil Aviation
to start first "notice-based' flying; and
(d) if so, the details of the "Notice-Based"
flying?
Import of T-90 tanks from Russia
121. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of T-90 tanks imported
from Russia; and
(b) whether T-90 is capable of countering
T-80 tanks acquired by Pakistan from
Ukraine?
Admiral Gorshkov
122. SHRIMATI BIMBA  RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India has concluded the final
deal on the acquisition of Russian aircraft
carrier Admiral Gorshkov, during the recent
visit of our Prime Minister to Russia;
(b) whether India has the expertise to
assess the sea-worthiness of Admiral
Gorshkov and whether any international
experts/valuers were engaged to evaluate
the deal; and
(c) to what extent the acquisition of
Admiral Gorshkov will enhance our naval
capabilities?
Import of bullet proof jackets
123. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government

4
are planning to import bull et-proof jackets
for our Jawans to fight with terrorists and
enemies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any field tests have been
conducted;
(d) if so, the out come of the field tests;
and
(e) the specifications that the Ministry
has set in for importing bullet proof jackets?
Recruitment of foreign nationals
in Defence forces
124. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the nationals of PoK and Bangladesh have
been recruited in the Defence forces through
recruitment centres as reported in the media;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to
recheck the antecedents of new recruits in
Defence forces in the past few years; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Grounding of Sukhoi-30 fighters
125. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Sukhoi-30 fighter planes
have been grounded on detection of 'nicks'
in the engine blades; and
(b) if so, the action taken to get the
defective parts replaced free of cost by the
manufacturers?
Occupation of defence land
126. SHRI MURLI DEORA: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the names of private parties including
Army Wives Welfare Association who have
been occupying defence lands and have not
got lease agreement renewed;
(b) the reasons therefor and loss caused
thereby; and
(c) the action taken to rectify the error?
Multi Barrel Rocket Launcher
127. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Defence Research and
Development Organisation have the
technology for production of Multi Barrel
Rocket Launcher; and
(b) if so, the reasons for purchasing
rocket launcher from Tata Group and not
producing by DRDO?
Acquisition of American attack
helicopters by Pakistan
128. SHRI DINA NATH MISHRA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the steps Government are
contemplating to counter Pakistan's
acquisition of American attack helicopters;
(b) the weapon-delivery system these
helicopters are equipped with and how high
and deep these can fly; and
(c) what is our threat perception in
regard to this development?

Spurious Liquor
129. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that spurious
liquor is being sold clandestinely in the
capital market as genuine Indian Made
Foreign Liquor, issued by the Canteen
Stores/ Department;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Military
police has recently arrested a few persons
found involved in the sale of such spurious
liquor in the capital; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and what
action has been taken against the accused
persons?
Raising of Territorial Army with
ex-militants
130. PROF. M. SANKARALINGAM:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether government propose to raise
a Territorial Army with ex-militants to
counter insurgency;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) steps taken by Government to
tackle and to stop spread of insurgency in
different parts of the country?
Accidents in Bharat Dynamic Ltd.
131. DR. DASARI NARA YANA
RAO: Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) how many major and minor accidents
have occurred in Bharat Dynamic Ltd.,
Hyderabad during the last five years,
year-wise;
(b) the number of workers killed or
injured in such accidents, year-wise and
total loss caused in accident;
(c) the compensation paid to the
affected ones in each of these accidents;
and
(d) the preventive measures taken to
avoid such accidents in future?
Mid-air collision between drone
and MIG-21
132. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a mid-air collision between
a newly-acquired drone and a MIG-21
fighter has occurred over the Bhatinda
airbase in Punjab on October, 24, 2003;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Funds for Cantonment Boards of
Uttaranchal
†133. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the amount of civic amenities like
potable water, sanitation and construction
of roads during the year 2003-04 to the
various Cantonment Boards of Uttaranchal
State;
(b) whether Government are aware of
the fact that all these Cantonment Boards
have not been able to maintain civic amenities
for want of funds;
(c) if so, whether there is any proposal
for allocation of additional funds to these
Cantonment Boards; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

6
Contract for purchase of
HAWK-115
134. SHRI PREM CHAND GUPTA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have signed a contract for the purchase of
66 HAWK Type-115 trainer aircraft from
British Aerospace after an evaluation period
of 20 years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the Rapid
Action Force are now flying an advanced
version of the HAWK, Type-128, which
indicates that the Type-115 is now
obsolete; and
(c) if so, the reason for Government
opting for the obsolete Type-115 when the
current Type-126 is now in service?
Procurement of Phalcon Early
Warning System
135.SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India has recently signed
deals on procurement of Phalcon Early
Warning System with  Israel and Control
Radar equipment with Russia;
(b) if so, whether these Phalcon systems
from Israel will be mounted on IL-76
Russian made aircrafts; and
(c) if so, whether it is a fact that Russia
has suspended production of IL-76 version
and if so, how India propose to use the
Phalcon systems contracted with Isreal?
Pension to Territorial Army
Personnel
136. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government at any point
of time decided to award pension to any
category of persons belonging to Territorial
Army who had fought the three battles of
1962, 1965 and 1971;
(b) whether Government propose to
award pension to thse persons; and
(c) if no, the reasons therefor?
Vacancies in Coast Guard
137. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) the details of vacancies in the Coast
Guard lying vacant during the last five
years; year-wise and category-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that shortage of
men and material in Coast Guard is affecting
the challenges to internal security posed
by the increasing use of sea lanes for
terrorists movement, gun running and
narcotics smuggling; and
(c) if so, how Government propose to
overcome the difficulties?
Rehabilitation of Kashmiri Pandits
138. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the proposal made by Hindu Welfare Society
Kashmir about "clusterisation" of Pandits
setting 10-15 Pandit families that are fully
integrated with a wider Muslim
neighbourhood and adequately protected by
security forces, and later, if successful,
such clusters could be increased and
uprooted Pandit families brought back from
Jammu region and also from other parts of
the country; and
(b) if so, whether such a scheme will be
launched especially when conditions are
becoming comparatively better under the
present political set-up?

7
Allotment of employees between
U.P. and Uttaranchal
139. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the State of Uttaranchal has
referred certain disputed issues to Central
Government for decision with regard to
matter of allotment of employees between
the State of Uttaranchal and Uttar Pradesh;
and
(b) if so, the details of such cases
alongwith the steps taken by Central
Government in this regard?
Co-ordination Committee to deal
naxal menace
140. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Co-ordination Committee
on Naxal-affected States headed by Union
Home Secretary, formed about five years
back has made any recommendations and
evolved common strategies to effectively
